title: Mastering The Crafts
description: An optimized Vanilla+ Minecraft modpack enhancing your world with stunning visuals, dynamic skies, and lush foliage. Built for builders and adventurers, MTC delivers seamless performance and essential quality-of-life upgrades.
body:
Mastering The Crafts (MTC) is a Minecraft modpack focused on improving the vanilla experience with quality-of-life features, visual enhancements, and useful client-side additions.

The modpack includes improvements such as minimaps, chat enhancements, visual effects, inventory improvements, and other small additions designed to make gameplay more enjoyable while keeping the core Minecraft experience familiar.

MTC is intended for players who want a polished and convenient Minecraft experience without major gameplay overhauls.
